title: Feature Recommendations as You Browse
description: Learn how Oasis intelligently recommends features and extensions as you browse, helping you discover useful tools that enhance your browsing experience.
content:
Oasis browser includes an intelligent feature recommendation system that suggests useful extensions and tools as you browse the web. This system analyzes your browsing patterns and suggests relevant features that can enhance your productivity, security, and overall browsing experience. Understanding how these recommendations work can help you discover valuable tools and customize your browser to better suit your needs.

Pro Tip

Feature recommendations are designed to enhance your browsing experience by suggesting relevant tools and utilities. However, always review extension permissions and user reviews before installing to ensure they meet your needs and privacy requirements.

How Feature Recommendations Work

Oasis uses intelligent algorithms to analyze your browsing behavior and suggest relevant features:

Browsing Pattern Analysis

  • Analyzes websites you frequently visit
  • Identifies common tasks and workflows
  • Recognizes patterns in your browsing behavior
  • Understands the context of your activities

Smart Suggestions

  • Suggests extensions based on current website
  • Recommends tools for specific tasks
  • Offers productivity enhancements
  • Proposes security and privacy tools

Quality Filtering

  • Curates extensions from trusted developers
  • Verifies extension security and privacy
  • Ensures compatibility with Oasis
  • Monitors extension performance and reviews

User Experience

  • Provides relevant suggestions without being intrusive
  • Allows users to dismiss or ignore recommendations
  • Offers clear information about extension functionality
  • Enables easy installation and management

Types of Feature Recommendations

Productivity Tools

Extensions that help you work more efficiently:

  • Task Management: To-do lists, project management tools, and workflow organizers
  • Time Tracking: Productivity monitors and time management utilities
  • Note Taking: Quick note capture and bookmark management tools
  • Workflow Automation: Tools that automate repetitive tasks
  • Communication: Email, messaging, and collaboration enhancements

Privacy and Security

Tools that protect your data and enhance security:

  • Ad Blockers: Remove unwanted advertisements and trackers
  • Privacy Enhancers: Additional privacy protection tools
  • Password Managers: Secure password storage and generation
  • VPN Extensions: Virtual private network access
  • Security Scanners: Tools to detect and prevent security threats

Content Enhancement

Tools that improve how you interact with web content:

  • Reading Tools: Readability enhancers and text formatting
  • Translation: Language translation services
  • Media Downloaders: Tools for downloading videos and media
  • Image Tools: Image editing and management utilities
  • Video Enhancers: Video playback improvements and controls

Developer Tools

Extensions for web development and technical users:

  • Code Editors: In-browser code editing capabilities
  • Debugging Tools: Web development debugging utilities
  • API Testing: REST API testing and development tools
  • Performance Monitoring: Website performance analysis
  • Version Control: Git and repository management

Managing Feature Recommendations

Enabling Recommendations

To receive feature recommendations:

  1. Open Oasis Settings or Preferences
  2. Navigate to the Privacy & Security section
  3. Find the "Data Collection and Use" section
  4. Enable "Allow Oasis to send technical and interaction data to Mozilla"
  5. Enable "Allow Oasis to install and run studies" (optional)
  6. Restart Oasis to apply changes

Disabling Recommendations

To stop receiving feature recommendations:

  1. Open Oasis Settings or Preferences
  2. Go to the Privacy & Security section
  3. Find the "Data Collection and Use" section
  4. Disable "Allow Oasis to send technical and interaction data to Mozilla"
  5. Disable "Allow Oasis to install and run studies"
  6. Clear any stored recommendation data

Customizing Recommendations

Fine-tune your recommendation experience:

  • Dismiss Recommendations: Click "Not interested" to avoid similar suggestions
  • Rate Extensions: Provide feedback to improve future recommendations
  • Install Extensions: Installing recommended extensions helps refine suggestions
  • Review Permissions: Always review extension permissions before installing
  • Report Issues: Report problematic or inappropriate recommendations

Privacy and Security Considerations

Data Collection

Understanding what data is collected for recommendations:

  • Browsing Patterns: General browsing behavior (not specific URLs)
  • Extension Usage: Which extensions you have installed
  • Performance Data: How extensions perform on your system
  • User Feedback: Your ratings and reviews of extensions
  • Technical Information: Browser version and system compatibility

Privacy Protection

How Oasis protects your privacy:

  • Anonymization: Data is anonymized before analysis
  • Local Processing: Some analysis happens locally on your device
  • Opt-out Options: You can disable data collection entirely
  • Transparent Policies: Clear information about data usage
  • User Control: You control what data is shared
Privacy Note

Oasis's feature recommendation system is designed with privacy in mind. Data collection is minimal, anonymized, and you have full control over what information is shared. You can disable recommendations entirely if you prefer not to share any data.

Best Practices for Feature Management

Before Installing Features

Always review extensions carefully before installation:

  • Read Descriptions: Understand what the extension does
  • Check Permissions: Review what data the extension can access
  • Read Reviews: Look at user reviews and ratings
  • Verify Developer: Check the developer's reputation and history
  • Consider Alternatives: Look for similar extensions to compare

After Installing Features

Monitor and manage your installed extensions:

  • Test Functionality: Ensure the extension works as expected
  • Monitor Performance: Watch for any impact on browser speed
  • Review Permissions: Periodically check extension permissions
  • Update Regularly: Keep extensions updated for security
  • Remove Unused: Uninstall extensions you no longer use

Security Considerations

Maintain security when using extensions:

  • Limit Permissions: Only grant necessary permissions
  • Use Trusted Sources: Install from official extension stores
  • Monitor Activity: Watch for unusual extension behavior
  • Report Issues: Report suspicious or malicious extensions
  • Regular Audits: Periodically review all installed extensions

Troubleshooting Feature Recommendations

No Recommendations Appearing

If you're not seeing feature recommendations:

  1. Check if data collection is enabled in Oasis settings
  2. Ensure you're using a supported Oasis version
  3. Clear browser cache and cookies
  4. Check your privacy settings and tracking protection
  5. Restart Oasis and try again
  6. Contact Mozilla support if issues persist

Irrelevant Recommendations

If recommendations don't match your needs:

  1. Dismiss irrelevant recommendations to improve future suggestions
  2. Install extensions that are relevant to your needs
  3. Provide feedback on recommendation quality
  4. Clear browsing data to reset recommendation patterns
  5. Wait for the system to learn your preferences

Performance Issues

If recommendations cause performance problems:

  1. Disable feature recommendations temporarily
  2. Check for conflicting extensions
  3. Update Oasis to the latest version
  4. Clear browser cache and temporary files
  5. Contact Mozilla support for assistance

Feature Recommendation Benefits

Enhanced Functionality

Feature recommendations help you discover tools that can enhance your browsing experience, improve productivity, and add useful features to your browser.

Curated Quality

Oasis's recommendation system focuses on high-quality, well-reviewed extensions that respect user privacy and provide genuine value.

Personalized Experience

Recommendations are tailored to your browsing patterns and preferences, making them more relevant and useful.

Security Focus

All recommended features undergo security review to ensure they don't compromise your privacy or system security.

Additional Resources

For more detailed information about feature recommendations, we recommend:

Mozilla Extension Recommendations Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Mozilla's Recommended Extensions Program - Information about curated extensions

Firefox Add-ons Store - Browse and discover Firefox extensions

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis's feature recommendation system. The recommendations and features described are specific to Oasis's approach. Other browsers may have different recommendation systems, criteria, and privacy policies. Always review extension details, permissions, and user reviews before installing any extension, regardless of the source.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it benefits from Mozilla's extension recommendation system and can access the vast Firefox extension ecosystem.
